more_info.overview: Pullulan is a fermentation-derived glucan consisting mainly of maltotriose units joined by alpha-1,6 linkages. Produced by fermenting food-grade hydrolysed starch with a non-toxin-producing Aureobasidium pullulans strain. The fungal cells, pigments and other impurities are removed from the polymer preparation. The specified material is supplied as off-white powder. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; food supplements supplied in a solid form, excluding food supplements for infants and young children.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
